execution.gpu_policy: GPU5/6/7 fixed seeds2026092701/02/03; launch only when total compute apps<2 and free>=10000MiB including existing training/foreign owner. <=2 own/card, <=6 total own GPU workers. Existing training/raw owners preserved. One independent CPU scorer; existing raw owner retains CPU scoring allocation until terminal.
execution.stop_rule: Two identical technical failure fingerprints stop new GPU dispatch; preserve all healthy work and artifacts. No performance-based stop, reorder or selective rerun. Smoke failure stops before target.

metrics_plan.prediction_ref: Canonical frozen default-head evaluator; reuse exact existing raw npz IDs, add only fixed DURA-LU predictions. All seven views fixed before independent truth-side scoring.
